notes:
Inbound from marketing form + product tour. Small-mid size tutoring platform (K-12 supplemental tutoring, in-classroom augmentation). Key ask: lightweight classroom copilot for teachers + student question moderation.

Initial discovery call with CEO (03/02) + product demo (03/05). Quote from CEO: "We need something low-friction — students and teachers can’t wait in queues for responses. Cost matters; ROI must show within a term." Wants self-serve path; open to Redwood hosted API if data retention and PII controls are clear.

Technical details gleaned: majority of traffic is short-chat Q&A and auto-feedback on student prose (avg prompt 20-80 tokens, expected bursty during after-school hours). Throughput target: 5-10 concurrent chat sessions per tutor node, p50 latency <400ms for short replies. Cost sensitivity high — looking to keep per-seat cost < $1/month additional if possible.

Security: SSO via Google Workspace required for teacher/admin flows; student accounts are pseudonymous, but they want audit logging for teacher overrides. No immediate on-prem requirement; prefer public cloud. Data residency: prefers NA-only but not a hard blocker for initial pilot.

Model prefs: open models or small mixing strategy to control cost. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/cache suggestions) to reduce token costs. Also asked about moderation filters and built-in safety; wants simple off-the-shelf moderation rules and the ability to tune thresholds per classroom.

Sales notes: inbound sign-up on 02/28 (self-serve trial). Logged spike in API usage March 3 during sandbox. Price sensitivity — will likely start on pay-as-you-go then move to small committed seat-based plan if pilot metrics look good.

Contact cadence: AE (Liam) to send pricing summary + sample prompt set by 03/11. SE (Priya) to run quick perf test with a sample teacher prompt set (see drive link) and demo batching recommendations on 03/18 call. CFO loop for budget approval scheduled week of 03/22.
